hazards: A block must not overwrite shared es/xr until all warps complete previous item; first valid item codebook load must be fenced. Uniform group skipping and zero-live groups must not deadlock.
Dynamic *n_groups is device-resident; cap by host maximum; empty and overprovisioned groups must write nothing.
Per-specialization/device occupancy and changing devices/streams need distinct cached results; query failures must not admit unknown grid.
New kernel shape can change compiler register/spill choices despite unchanged arithmetic; validate exact GPU outputs and resources.
Changed timing may alter asynchronous expert-cache residency. Kernel exactness alone does not guarantee same whole-model sampled token path.
arithmetic_and_memory.index_safety: Positive aligned dimensions/groups bound work-product to INT_MAX. Persistent loop index is long long, preventing overflow on final stride; derived grp/bx are bounded int.
